name: Bakunyuu Chikan Train ~Bokura no Yuuki Chikan Toshi~
original_name: 爆乳痴漢トレイン～ぼくらの勇気・痴漢都市～
source:
Spring. It is time to "switch".
Enrolling into a school, graduating, finding a job... as those destinations change, the means of transportation change as well.

A change... definitely occurred on the train's platform I am gazing at right now.
Sitting still on a bench while looking at the platform packed with people, I am searching for this "year"s game.

I have an aesthetics.
The kind of aesthetics that, once decided, makes me obsess over a game on and on until the next spring. It is an important task that will determine this entire year. I stare at the crowd more and more thoroughly. At that moment, a single female student crosses in front of my eyes.

"That's it..."

A girl packing a chest so big into an uniform looking so tight it is a crime.
I do not hesitate anymore.
This year's game will be this girl!

I quietly stand behind her and...

[Translated from the [url=http://pin-point.biz/03_tikan/story.htm]official website[/url]]
